Anthropic Claude

Reasoning and writing with controlled tool access.

ACOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Use Claude models for analysis, writing, document interpretation, and tool-assisted business tasks. MoreSpace can build a reviewer workspace that summarizes supplied material, prepares proposals, and calls defined functions when the operator's role allows it. Outputs are checked against source documents and tested on realistic cases before they become part of a customer-facing process.

Useful outputs

  • Structured analysis and response drafts
  • Proposed tool actions with arguments
  • Review notes and exception records

Where we can apply it

  • Discovery notes → proposal outline → commercial review → client-ready draft.
  • Account history → concise sales briefing → owner review → meeting preparation.
  • Support request → classification → permitted lookup → response draft and escalation.

Inputs we need

  • Approved account or service documents
  • A clear task rubric
  • Role-scoped function definitions

Delivery sequence

  • Define source boundaries and build a representative evaluation set.
  • Implement the tool loop with input validation and role-aware checks.
  • Review unsupported claims and route ambiguous requests to a human owner.

Expert review points

  • Verify summaries preserve important dates, commitments, and source meaning.
  • Separate suggested actions from actual execution permissions.
